```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Keep the same background look as the chapter.
backgroundcolor <- "#fffafa"
```

This temporary document compares the current density-based histograms in Chapter 7 with count-based alternatives, side by side, using the same simulated data in each pair.

## Figure: Prediction Interval Plot (Main Chapter Figure)

```{r}
set.seed(1009)
n <- 20
x <- rnorm(n = n, mean = 100, sd = 15)

ciu <- mean(x) + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sd(x) * sqrt(1 / n)
cil <- mean(x) - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sd(x) * sqrt(1 / n)

piu <- mean(x) + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sd(x) * sqrt(1 + 1 / n)
pil <- mean(x) - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sd(x) * sqrt(1 + 1 / n)

df_x <- as.data.frame(x)

p_density <- ggplot(df_x, aes(x)) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = pil, xmax = piu, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf), fill = "gold") +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = cil, xmax = ciu, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf), fill = "#E69F00") +
  geom_histogram(colour = "black", fill = "grey", aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 20) +
  xlab("Score") +
  ylab("Density") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = backgroundcolor)) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = backgroundcolor)) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()) +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(x), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(50, 150)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(seq(50, 150, 10))) +
  labs(subtitle = paste("Mean =", round(mean(x)), "| SD =", round(sd(x)))) +
  ggtitle("Current (Density)")

p_count <- ggplot(df_x, aes(x)) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = pil, xmax = piu, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf), fill = "gold") +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = cil, xmax = ciu, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf), fill = "#E69F00") +
  geom_histogram(colour = "black", fill = "grey", bins = 20) +
  xlab("Score") +
  ylab("Count") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = backgroundcolor)) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = backgroundcolor)) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()) +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(x), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(50, 150)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(seq(50, 150, 10))) +
  labs(subtitle = paste("Mean =", round(mean(x)), "| SD =", round(sd(x)))) +
  ggtitle("Count Version")
```

n <- 20

cil2 <- mean(x2) - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sd(x2) * sqrt(1 / n)

piu2 <- mean(x2) + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sd(x2) * sqrt(1 + 1 / n)
pil2 <- mean(x2) - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sd(x2) * sqrt(1 + 1 / n)

df_x2 <- as.data.frame(x2)

p_density2 <- ggplot(df_x2, aes(x)) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = pil2, xmax = piu2, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf), fill = "gold") +

p_count2 <- ggplot(df_x2, aes(x)) +
